## Plugin reference

- Description: Places fixtures, server half: writePlacesFixture writes a PlacesFixture through the app's real write paths — the starter tag tree a fresh install seeds, the fixture's tags through the tag tree's own endpoints (create path, then colour and icon), each place through insertPlace with its icon given — so no Google call and no model is needed. Derives nothing else.
- Server:
  - Uses:
    - `apps/places/places-core.insertPlace`
    - `apps/places/places-core.NewPlace`
    - `apps/places/places-core.seedStarterPlaceTags`
    - `primitives/data-view.dataViewStorePath`
    - `primitives/data-view.readDataViewConfigDoc`
  - Exports (values): `writePlacesFixture`
- Core:
  - Exports (types):
    - `PlaceFixture`
    - `PlaceFixtureSource`
    - `PlacePresetFixture`
    - `PlacesFixture`
    - `PlaceTagFixture`
    - `PlaceTagPath`
